current_matching_error.description: Percentage difference between output current and reference current.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure current matching, output resistance, and power consumption of the PMOS current mirror.
step3_testbench.spice:
* PMOS Current Mirror Testbench
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM1 N0 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N6 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N4 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
Vshort N0 N1 0
Iref N0 0 10u

V2 N2 0 0.9
V3 N6 0 0.9
V4 N4 0 0.9

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.control
  op
  let i_ref = 10u
  let i_out2 = -i(V2)
  let i_out3 = -i(V3)
  let i_out4 = -i(V4)
  let match_error = (i_out2 - i_ref) / i_ref * 100
  let total_power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print i_out2 i_out3 i_out4 match_error total_power
  
  dc V2 0 1.8 0.01
  let i_out_sweep = -i(V2)
  meas dc i_800 find i_out_sweep at=0.8
  meas dc i_1000 find i_out_sweep at=1.0
  let rout_calc = 0.2 / abs(i_1000 - i_800)
  print rout_calc
  
  quit
.endc
.end
